Standard: Avoidance of a spin reversal or an adverse mode change does not depend upon precise pilot control, timing, or deflection. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess piloting techniques and timing to avoid adverse spin mode change or spin reversal for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess piloting techniques and timing to avoid adverse spin mode change or spin reversal for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess piloting techniques and timing to avoid adverse spin mode change or spin reversal for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
